summary: Iteration 14: Validated REAL Tuya discovery (source=tuya), SIM retrocompat, security (no product_id/tuya_id leak), associate flow and PairingPanel UI. Found and FIXED a real security bug: associate_pairing returned tuya_id in device response.
action_items: Verify the fix applied to associate_pairing (server.py L1127: added dev.pop('tuya_id', None)) is acceptable and add explicit unit protection if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY BUG (FIXED by testing agent): server.py associate_pairing was leaking 'tuya_id' in the returned device object — it only popped 'product_id'. Added dev.pop('tuya_id', None). Requirement explicitly asked device response to hide both.
public_pairing and public_devices correctly strip product_id + tuya_id.
discover_tuya_devices maps HTTP 502 on cloud errors (never 500), respects Tuya page_size=20 limit, deduplicates by known tuya_id.
Backend endpoint /api/admin/tuya/projects (not /admin/tuya-projects) — noted for future agents.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_DiscoverTuya installation via installer fixture and cleaned up via yield/DELETE. No touch to 'Maison Client Démo', 'ecozone', 'Test' or the active Tuya project.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Tuya cloud IS reachable and IP is whitelisted. Real discovery now returns 200 with a list — currently returns 1 device ('Thermostat Entrée' CZ-AABD90CD) linked in the SmartLife account (not empty as originally stated). Toast/UI messaging works. PairingPanel data-testids: pairing-mode-real, pairing-mode-sim, scan-category-select, scan-count-input, scan-devices-btn — all functional; category/count correctly hidden in real mode, shown in sim mode.
rca of the issue: Bug RCA — tuya_id leak in associate response: In server.py associate_pairing (~L1125), the code only popped 'product_id' from the device dict before returning. Because Device includes tuya_id (needed internally to link cloud state), it was serialized in the response. Fix: added dev.pop('tuya_id', None) alongside product_id. Reproduction: POST /installations/{iid}/pairing/{pid}/associate on any pairing (even sim, since Device model always has tuya_id key) — response.device contained 'tuya_id' (null for sim, real cloud ID for tuya-sourced pairing). Post-fix: field is absent.
